CLM14994555102016-12-2119Application No.: 14/994,555Attorney Docket No.: 11541-0039-01000AMENDMENTS TO THE CLAIMS:This listing of claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in the application:
1. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method of assessment of visceral ischemia and related disorders, the method comprising:receiving a patient-specific anatomic model of a patient's visceral vasculature, including visceral vasculature of the patient's visceral organs and including a portion of a patient's bowel;determining a location of modeled visceral vasculature in the patient-specific anatomic model of the patient's visceral vasculature;determining a tissue region of the patient's bowel distal to the location in the patient-specific anatomic model of the patient's visceral vasculature;determining a mass of the portion of the patient's bowel;determining a blood flow demand of the determined tissue region portion of the patient's bowel based on the determined mass;determining, using the blood flow demand, a blood flow characteristic of blood delivered to the portion of the patient's bowel; associated with the determined location of the modeled visceral vasculature and/or the determined tissue region; andgenerating or displaying an assessment of blood supply adequacy defining an adequacy of blood supply to [[the]] a tissue region of the patient's viscera or bowel based on the determined blood flow characteristic, or-2-Application No.: 14/994,555Attorney Docket No.: 11541-0039-01000generating or displaying a risk score defining a risk of disease of the patient's viscera or bowel, based on the determined blood flow characteristic and an expected blood flow characteristic associated with [[the]] a tissue region of the patient's bowel based on the determined blood flow characteristic.currently amendedIndependent
2. (Previously Presented) The computer-implemented method of claim 1,wherein the blood flow characteristic includes one or more of blood pressure, flow rate, fractional flow reserve, or portal venous pressure.previously presentedDependent
3. (Currently Amended) The computer-implemented method of claim 1,further comprising:receiving a physiological state associated with the patient; and the patient- specific anatomic model including at least a portion of the patient's bowel;further determining the blood flow [[demand]] characteristic based on [[a]] the received physiological state and the portion of the patient's bowel; anddetermining the assessment of blood supply adequacy based on the determined blood flow demand and the determined blood flow characteristic at the location in the patient-specific model of the patient's visceral vasculature.currently amendedDependent
4. 5. (Currently Amended) The computer-implemented method of claim 1,further comprising:determining the blood flow characteristic at the location of the patient-specific anatomic model of the patient's visceral vasculature using a fluid simulation or using blood flow characteristics associated with one or more other patients.currently amendedDependent
6. (Currently Amended) The computer-implemented method of claim 1,further comprising:further determining the blood flow characteristic based on a value of a microvascular resistance.receiving a physiological state associated with the patient; andgenerating the assessment of blood supply adequacy to the patient's bowel or generating the risk score for risk of disease for the patient's viscera or bowel, further based on the received physiological state.currently amendedDependent
